title: Autoscoring Anticlimax: A Meta-analytic Understanding of AI’s Short-answer Shortcomings and Wording Weaknesses

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates racial bias in two ways: 1) Comparison of automated scores and qualitative feedback assigned by ChatGPT to identical student essays attributed to either a "White" or "Black" student via prompt manipulation. 2) Analysis of AI-generated Individualized Education Program (IEP) interventions for hypothetical students explicitly labeled as "Black", "Hispanic", or "White", coding the resulting recommendations for disparities in resource allocation and behavioral management.
